purpose: Compare original and proposed source with split/unified layouts, change navigation and optional proposed editing.
behaviorProvider: CodeMirror MergeView/unifiedMergeView with shared code extensions.

component: Keep original read-only in split mode and configure unified comparison without merge controls. readOnly defaults true and governs only the proposed/modified editor.

Use controlled mode or initialize local mode from defaultMode. Layout actions update local state only uncontrolled and report onModeChange; rebuild and destroy editor instances when mode/options change.
Replace changed original/modified documents in mounted editors when props update, suppressing onModifiedChange for these external transactions. User document edits emit the latest modified text.
host: Own approval/rejection, persistence and accepted modified state. Feed onModifiedChange back when editing; proposal content is not automatically accepted or merged into a server document.
Use modifiedIntent=ai only for provenance styling. It does not certify correctness, author identity, review completion or authorization.

requirements.statement: Keep original read-only in split mode and configure unified comparison without merge controls. readOnly defaults true and governs only the proposed/modified editor.

Use controlled mode or initialize local mode from defaultMode. Layout actions update local state only uncontrolled and report onModeChange; rebuild and destroy editor instances when mode/options change.

Compute changed section and added/removed line counts from merge chunks, expose a status and hidden comparison instructions, and disable previous/next actions when no chunks exist.
Previous/next change commands act on the proposed editor and focus it. focusFirstChange scrolls/selects the first change without explicitly calling focus.

Keep local collapse state synchronized from collapseUnchanged and the Focus changes/Show all lines action. Enhance collapsed widgets with button role, keyboard focus, Enter/Space activation and editor focus restoration.
Destroy MergeView/EditorView instances on rebuild/unmount, and disconnect collapsed-context observers and event listeners during plugin destruction.
Own approval/rejection, persistence and accepted modified state. Feed onModifiedChange back when editing; proposal content is not automatically accepted or merged into a server document.

Consume code group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: Document replacements and option changes may reset selection/history; this is not collaborative version control.
No chunk accept/reject controls, conflict resolution or native form field is provided.
